name: Transept
author: E. T. Carter
description: A gothic nave recedes toward a glowing triple lancet; low sun pours through the stained clerestory on the left and cuts cyan, magenta and lime shafts across the dark, laying window-shaped pools on the polished flagstones and far arcade. Dust drifts through the beams, motes glint as they cross them, and passing cloud slowly swells and thins the light.

params.label: Sunlight
params.effect: Strength of the sun through the glass: from a dim blue nave to blazing coloured shafts and floor pools.

params.label: Dust
params.effect: How much dust hangs in the air: faint ghost beams at zero, thick solid shafts and many motes at the top.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the drifting dust, the floating motes and the passing cloud.
